overview.en: xEthWETH is an ERC-20 voucher token used in the AetheriumX Voucher Vault to represent supported ETH/WETH staking positions for on-chain accounting, yield allocation records, and unstaking/redemption processing.
overview.zh: xEthWETH 是 AetheriumX Voucher Vault 中的 ERC-20 质押凭证代币，用于表示受支持的 ETH/WETH 质押仓位，并服务于链上记账、收益分配记录及解押/赎回流程。
